steps.en: Officer opens a report screen and starts it
steps.id: Officer membuka layar report dan menjalankannya
steps.why_en: The screen is a different report, not the one the story describes.
steps.why_id: Layar ini report lain, bukan report yang dimaksud story.

steps.en: Vehicle numbers of notices of deceased individuals are identified
steps.id: Nomor kendaraan notice individu meninggal diidentifikasi
steps.why_en: Only deceased hirers/drivers with PS-RP2 are covered, not all deceased individuals.
steps.why_id: Hanya hirer/driver meninggal dengan PS-RP2, bukan semua individu meninggal.

steps.en: Selection uses pre-defined criteria such as outstanding notices per ID
steps.id: Pemilihan memakai kriteria pre-defined, mis. jumlah notice outstanding per ID
steps.why_en: No rule on how many notices an ID has outstanding exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan jumlah notice outstanding per ID.

steps.en: Latest ownership of the identified vehicles is fetched from DOS
steps.id: Data kepemilikan terbaru kendaraan diambil dari DOS
steps.why_en: The report does not ask LTA/DOS for ownership.
steps.why_id: Report tidak meminta data kepemilikan ke LTA/DOS.
